name: Bond market volatility
summary: MOVE index 99 and US 10-year yield 5.15% on 13 Nov; MOVE has not cleared the exit margin, so Watch holds
state: The MOVE index of Treasury volatility was near 99 on 13 Nov, 6% higher on the week but 4% lower over a month, and the US 10-year yield was near 5.15%, about 6bp higher than a month earlier (Yahoo Finance). MOVE sits just under the 100 Watch line but has not cleared the exit margin, so Watch holds; the 10-year is 16bp below its 52-week high of 5.31%.
for_you: Volatile Treasury yields tend to feed through to mortgage and borrowing costs internationally. Holders of bond funds are exposed to price swings.
rubric_hit: MOVE 98.8 has not yet cleared the 90 exit line, so Watch holds

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — ICE BofAML MOVE Index (^MOVE)

why: US Treasuries price almost every asset on earth; when the 'risk-free' market becomes volatile, funding and collateral chains strain.
drivers: Inflation data, Fed path, deficits and auction demand, foreign holder flows, liquidity.

rubric.alert: MOVE > 140, or disorderly Treasury trading (failed/tailed auctions with Fed action, emergency buybacks).
rubric.watch: MOVE 100–140, or US 10y moved ≥ 40bp in a month, or weak auctions flagged.
rubric.normal: MOVE index < 100 and US 10y moved < 40bp over the past month.
